# Representative bash-command corpus sampled from typical dev workflows.
# Lines starting with `#` are comments. Blank / whitespace-only lines ARE
# part of the corpus (they exercise the Empty reason path). Counting rule
# in the test: a line is a sample iff it is not a comment.
#
# This fixture drives `approval_rationale_baseline.rs` — a guard-rail test
# that locks the *distribution* of classification verdicts from
# `bash_command_approval_reason`. If a classifier change causes the
# distribution to drift (e.g. benign commands suddenly all classified as
# mutating), the test fails and surfaces user-visible UX regression
# before it ships.
#
# Keep the corpus roughly balanced. Counts are asserted as ranges, not
# exact numbers, so small additions here are fine — but moving a command
# from one category to another is a conscious choice and the test will
# tell you.

# ── read-only: navigation & inspection ───────────────────────
ls
ls -la
ls rust/crates
pwd
whoami
date
cat Cargo.toml
cat README.md
head -20 rust/crates/runtime/src/lib.rs
tail -50 /tmp/log.txt
wc -l src/main.rs
file /bin/bash
stat Cargo.toml
which cargo
type cargo
echo hello
echo "build complete"
printf "%s\n" hello
true
false

# ── read-only: search & filter ───────────────────────────────
grep -r TODO src/
grep -n "fn main" src/main.rs
rg --type rust bash_command
find . -name "*.rs"
find rust/crates -type f -name Cargo.toml
sort file.txt
uniq -c file.txt
cut -d, -f1 data.csv
awk "{print \$1}" file.txt
sed -n "1,10p" file.txt

# ── read-only: build/test/git inspection ─────────────────────
cargo check
cargo check --workspace
cargo build --release
cargo test -p astra-turn-core
cargo clippy
cargo fmt --check
cargo tree
git status
git log --oneline -20
git diff HEAD~1
git show HEAD
git branch
git remote -v
npm list
npm outdated
pip list
go version

# ── read-only with benign fd redirects ───────────────────────
cargo check 2>&1 | head -50
cargo test 2>/dev/null
ls &>/dev/null
grep foo bar.txt &>> /tmp/search.log
echo hi > /dev/null
cargo build 1>/dev/null 2>&1

# ── pipes & composition (read-only) ──────────────────────────
ls | head -10
cat /etc/passwd | grep root
git log --oneline | head
ps aux | grep cargo | head -5
find . -name "*.rs" | wc -l

# ── write-indicator: file mutation ───────────────────────────
rm -rf target
rm file.txt
mv old.txt new.txt
cp src.txt dst.txt
mkdir -p build
touch newfile.txt
chmod +x script.sh
chown user:user file.txt
ln -s target link
sed -i "s/foo/bar/" file.txt
awk "{print}" file > out.txt
cat > /tmp/new.txt
echo test >> log.txt
tee output.log

# ── write-indicator: git/npm write verbs ─────────────────────
git commit -m msg
git add .
git push origin main
git pull
git checkout -b feature
git reset --hard
git clean -fd
npm install
npm update
pip install requests
cargo install ripgrep
apt install foo

# ── shell injection ──────────────────────────────────────────
ls $(pwd)
echo hi; rm file
true && rm file

# ── unknown prefix (not in allowlist) ────────────────────────
foobar_unknown
myscript.sh arg1 arg2
./custom_binary --flag
xyzzy --version

# ── empty / malformed ────────────────────────────────────────
